sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 420. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies Miasma for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies stun.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Paralyzes for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Only [Raucous Alchemist] Nicola can be used as Unlocking Potential material
